query:
UPDATE foods SET
            name = ?, brand = ?, barcode = ?, notes = ?,
            kcal_per_100 = ?, protein_g_per_100 = ?, carbs_g_per_100 = ?, fat_g_per_100 = ?,
            serving_qty = ?, serving_unit = ?, serving_label = ?, source = ?,
            updated_at = datetime('now')
        WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?
